name: pgNimbus
description: A fast, open-source PostgreSQL GUI client (.NET + Avalonia)

paragraphs: A fast PostgreSQL client that talks to your database and nothing else.
On screen in about 0.2 s. Results stream while the query runs. No telemetry, no account, no cloud.
features: It's fast where you wait. A NativeAOT binary, not Electron: about 0.2 s to a window, rows on screen while the query is still running, and Esc stops a query mid-flight. Measured on every release.
Your data stays yours. No telemetry, no update checks, no crash uploads, no account, no AI features. The only connections it opens go to your Postgres servers and SSH tunnels.
It's built for the keyboard. Ctrl+K reaches any table or command, a connection string in any format fills the form, and autocomplete reads SQL the way the server does.

Autocomplete that resolves names the way the server does: along searchpath, per query block (subqueries, CTEs, LATERAL), with one JOIN … ON condition offered per foreign key, argument hints for functions and only types…
Formatting that only ever changes whitespace, ;-separated scripts with a result section per statement, find and replace, .sql files, searchable query history and saved queries.
